meta.audience: United States adults age 18 and older

lanes.label: Becoming
lanes.description: User-shaped voice without a gendered lane.

areas.label: Onboarding
areas.description: Adult consent, transparency, personalization, privacy, and first value.

screens.title: Welcome to I AM
screens.summary: A calm introduction to a whole-life companion that turns conversation into real-world action.

screens.title: Adult confirmation
screens.summary: Confirm that this U.S. release is for adults age 18 or older.

screens.title: Know what you are talking to
screens.summary: Explain that responses come from AI, may be wrong, and do not replace qualified people or emergency services.

screens.title: Choose your support lane
screens.summary: Choose Him, Her, or Becoming without changing the product's safety rules or capabilities.

screens.title: How should I show up?
screens.summary: Set directness, warmth, humor, encouragement, and faith-sensitive language preferences.

screens.title: What matters right now?
screens.summary: Select career, relationships, emotional wellness, confidence, style, rebuilding, or another focus.

screens.title: Set the pace
screens.summary: Choose concise or detailed replies, question frequency, action focus, and reminder tone.

screens.title: Your memory choices
screens.summary: Choose whether the companion may propose memories. Nothing becomes memory without a visible user decision.

screens.title: Notifications on your terms
screens.summary: Opt into neutral reminders without sensitive text on the lock screen.

screens.title: Safety and emergencies
screens.summary: State that I AM is not monitored in real time and cannot contact emergency help.

screens.title: Create your private account
screens.summary: Use email, Google, or Apple sign-in after accepting terms, privacy, and required consent.

screens.title: How are you arriving today?
screens.summary: Capture a private starting point and choose one realistic next move.

areas.label: Home
areas.description: A personal command center focused on one useful move at a time.

screens.title: Your day, without the noise
screens.summary: See a lane-aware greeting, current focus, recent progress, and a clear next action.

screens.title: Quick check-in
screens.summary: Name the current feeling, energy, pressure, and support needed without turning it into a diagnosis.

screens.title: Today's move
screens.summary: Choose one achievable step pulled from the user's active goals and current capacity.

screens.title: What you are building
screens.summary: Show active goals, the next step, flexible timing, and progress without guilt or streak pressure.

screens.title: An insight worth keeping
screens.summary: Display a user-approved insight with a plain explanation of why it was saved and controls to edit or delete it.

screens.title: Find trusted support
screens.summary: Open verified national or local resources with source, review date, access methods, and availability notes.

screens.title: Private support options
screens.summary: Reach the Safety Path quickly without a dramatic label or a false promise that device traces can be erased.

areas.label: Talk
areas.description: Substantive conversation that can become an insight, plan, task, or resource.

screens.title: Conversations
screens.summary: See saved conversations, private-session entry, dates, and user-controlled deletion.

screens.title: What is on your mind?
screens.summary: Begin with text or voice and choose whether the conversation can be saved.

screens.title: A real conversation
screens.summary: Stream clear responses with visible AI identity, uncertainty, and action-oriented follow-through.

screens.title: Speak instead
screens.summary: Capture user-initiated voice input with visible recording state and editable transcription.

screens.title: What should happen next?
screens.summary: Regenerate, correct, save, share a user-safe excerpt, report, or turn the response into a plan.

screens.title: Save the part that matters
screens.summary: Edit the proposed insight, select its life area, and decide whether it may be remembered.

screens.title: Turn words into movement
screens.summary: Convert selected conversation content into an editable goal and realistic next steps.

screens.title: Private session
screens.summary: Use a conversation designed not to persist in cloud history, with an honest warning about device and network traces.

screens.title: Report this response
screens.summary: Report unsafe, offensive, inaccurate, manipulative, or otherwise harmful output to the protected review queue.

screens.title: Conversation settings
screens.summary: Adjust tone, memory proposals, faith-sensitive language, voice, accessibility, and conversation deletion.

screens.title: Need a safer path?
screens.summary: Leave the normal chat flow for immediate-danger guidance, safer-device notes, verified resources, and advocate options.

areas.label: Plan
areas.description: Editable goals, flexible steps, check-ins, and progress history.

screens.title: Choose the part of life to move
screens.summary: Start with career, relationships, wellness, confidence, style, rebuilding, or a custom area.

screens.title: Your active goals
screens.summary: See active, paused, completed, and archived goals without ranking the user's worth.

screens.title: The goal and the why
screens.summary: Show the user's wording, motivation, timeline, next step, obstacles, and progress history.

screens.title: Build a plan you can live with
screens.summary: Generate editable steps sized to time, energy, money, support, and real constraints.

screens.title: One step, clearly defined
screens.summary: Set the action, timing, support, obstacles, and definition of done.

screens.title: How did this step go?
screens.summary: Record progress, friction, confidence, and what should change next without shame.

screens.title: Adjust the plan, not your worth
screens.summary: Move, split, reduce, or pause a step while preserving the user's reason and history.

screens.title: Your progress history
screens.summary: See completed steps, changes, check-ins, and lessons without manipulative streak mechanics.

screens.title: That counted
screens.summary: Acknowledge real movement with calm celebration that never triggers during high-risk safety states.

screens.title: Close this chapter
screens.summary: Complete, pause, or archive a goal while preserving or deleting its history by user choice.

areas.label: Career Studio
areas.description: Career direction, résumé analysis, job alignment, interview practice, and application tracking.

screens.title: Career Studio
screens.summary: Choose direction, résumé, job match, interview practice, skills, applications, or negotiation.

screens.title: Where do you fit next?
screens.summary: Explore strengths, experience, needs, interests, constraints, and realistic role families without inventing qualifications.

screens.title: A path, not a promise
screens.summary: Compare role options, transferable skills, gaps, likely effort, and evidence needed.

screens.title: Upload your résumé
screens.summary: Select a supported file, review privacy notes, and confirm that no experience may be fabricated.

screens.title: Résumé review
screens.summary: Show strengths, risks, clarity issues, missing evidence, keyword fit, and user-approved revisions.

screens.title: Match the job to the truth
screens.summary: Compare a job description with verified résumé evidence and label matches, partial matches, gaps, and unknowns.

screens.title: Build the missing proof
screens.summary: Turn real gaps into learning, portfolio, certification, or experience steps without promising a job.

screens.title: Practice for the room
screens.summary: Choose role, level, format, focus areas, answer length, and pressure level.

screens.title: Interview practice
screens.summary: Answer one question at a time by text or voice with transparent AI evaluation.

screens.title: Make the answer stronger
screens.summary: Grade relevance, structure, evidence, clarity, and confidence without changing the user's history.

screens.title: Application tracker
screens.summary: Track roles, dates, stages, contacts, follow-ups, documents, and outcomes under user control.

screens.title: Prepare for the conversation
screens.summary: Organize priorities, market evidence, questions, boundaries, and fallback choices without legal or financial promises.

areas.label: Relationships
areas.description: Communication, boundaries, healthy-pattern education, concern detection, and breakup recovery.

screens.title: Relationship support
screens.summary: Choose communication preparation, boundaries, healthy signs, concern check, or recovery support.

screens.title: Prepare the conversation
screens.summary: Clarify the goal, facts, feelings, request, timing, and safer alternatives before a difficult talk.

screens.title: A boundary you can explain
screens.summary: Define the behavior, personal limit, response, and support plan without controlling another person.

screens.title: What healthy can look like
screens.summary: Review respect, repair, consent, trust, independence, honesty, and mutual responsibility.

screens.title: Check the pattern
screens.summary: Explore coercion, fear, isolation, threats, stalking, financial control, and escalation without diagnosing or making a safety guarantee.

screens.title: Getting through the ending
screens.summary: Build a practical recovery plan around contact, routines, support, triggers, identity, and next steps.

screens.title: Your relationship plan
screens.summary: Review and edit a conversation, boundary, recovery, or concern-response plan with privacy controls.

areas.label: Wellness Reset
areas.description: Reflection, routines, support connection, and grounded next steps without clinical claims.

screens.title: Wellness Reset
screens.summary: Choose a check-in, reset plan, support connection, routine, or reflection tool.

screens.title: Name what is happening
screens.summary: Describe feelings, thoughts, body cues, pressures, supports, and immediate needs without diagnosis.

screens.title: Build a gentle reset
screens.summary: Create small actions for sleep routine, food, movement, environment, obligations, and support while respecting health limitations.

screens.title: Bring a real person in
screens.summary: Choose a trusted person or qualified service and draft a simple message asking for support.

screens.title: A routine that bends
screens.summary: Build a realistic morning, workday, evening, or recovery routine that can be adjusted without shame.

screens.title: This may need more than an app
screens.summary: Encourage qualified care, crisis support, or emergency help based on risk without claiming to diagnose the user.

areas.label: Confidence & Style
areas.description: Identity, presentation, grooming, saved boards, budget awareness, and transparent shopping guidance.

screens.title: Confidence and style
screens.summary: Choose confidence reflection, preference profile, grooming, wardrobe, look board, or budget planning.

screens.title: What feels like you?
screens.summary: Capture comfort, fit, colors, maintenance, setting, identity, budget, and accessibility needs.

screens.title: A routine you can maintain
screens.summary: Build practical hair, skin, beard, makeup, or general-care options with health-safe caveats and no medical claims.

screens.title: Dress for the actual life
screens.summary: Plan outfits around work, events, climate, mobility, fit, existing items, and budget.

screens.title: Your look board
screens.summary: Save user-selected inspiration, notes, colors, pieces, and alternatives without implying inventory guarantees.

screens.title: Style without wrecking the budget
screens.summary: Set a spending limit, prioritize gaps, compare maintenance cost, and label affiliate relationships clearly.

areas.label: Safety Path
areas.description: Discreet, survivor-centered guidance, safer planning education, and verified resources.

screens.title: Private support
screens.summary: Enter a safety-focused flow with an immediate quick-exit control and honest device-trace warning.

screens.title: Are you in immediate danger?
screens.summary: Route immediate danger to emergency options and avoid keeping the user inside a long app flow.

screens.title: Could this device be monitored?
screens.summary: Explain that app, browser, account, network, location, and notification activity may be visible or recoverable.

screens.title: What kind of support fits?
screens.summary: Choose fear, threats, coercion, stalking, digital monitoring, financial control, escalating behavior, or general concern.

screens.title: Safety-plan workspace
screens.summary: Draft contacts, documents, transportation, medication, children/pets, signals, and safer locations without ordering the user to leave or confront anyone.

screens.title: Verified support resources
screens.summary: Show only verified, unexpired records with source, jurisdiction, contact methods, access notes, and review date.

screens.title: Connect with a trained advocate
screens.summary: Offer call, text, chat, or website options without pretending the app can hand off or monitor the contact in real time.

screens.title: Quick exit
screens.summary: Demonstrate a neutral destination while stating that a quick exit cannot erase browser, app, device, router, carrier, or account history.

screens.title: Understand the pattern
screens.summary: Offer survivor-centered information on escalation, coercive control, stalking, technology abuse, and support choices without making a diagnosis or prediction.

areas.label: Circles
areas.description: Adult, moderated community without direct messages or vulnerable-user solicitation.

screens.title: Circles
screens.summary: Browse active adult communities with rules, moderation status, and no direct-message feature.

screens.title: A moderated circle
screens.summary: Read posts, reactions, community rules, reporting controls, and visible moderation notices.

screens.title: Share without oversharing
screens.summary: Write a post with reminders not to expose addresses, credentials, precise location, safety-plan details, or identifying private information.

screens.title: Review before posting
screens.summary: Show moderation feedback, privacy warnings, and user-edit options before publication.

screens.title: Report community content
screens.summary: Report harassment, threats, doxxing, self-harm encouragement, exploitation, illegal content, impersonation, or other harm.

screens.title: Block this account
screens.summary: Prevent the blocked account's content from appearing to the user while preserving necessary moderation evidence.

screens.title: Community Standards
screens.summary: Explain adult-only participation, prohibited conduct, moderation, evidence preservation, appeals, and account restrictions.

areas.label: Memory Center
areas.description: Visible, consensual, editable, explainable, pausable, and deletable memory.

screens.title: Memory Center
screens.summary: See every saved memory, its category, source, date, status, and why it may influence responses.

screens.title: Why this was remembered
screens.summary: Show the exact saved statement, user approval, source conversation, purpose, and edit/delete controls.

screens.title: Remember this?
screens.summary: Present a concise proposed memory that can be edited, approved, or refused without pressure.

screens.title: Memory is paused
screens.summary: Explain what pausing changes, what remains stored, and how to delete stored memories separately.

screens.title: Delete this memory
screens.summary: Confirm deletion and explain that removing a memory does not necessarily delete its original conversation unless the user chooses that too.

areas.label: Profile & Subscription
areas.description: Identity, preferences, privacy, accessibility, notifications, entitlement, and account controls.

screens.title: Profile and settings
screens.summary: Open companion, life-area, memory, privacy, accessibility, notification, subscription, support, and deletion controls.

screens.title: Companion preferences
screens.summary: Change lane, tone, humor, faith-sensitive language, directness, detail, and question style.

screens.title: Privacy controls
screens.summary: Manage memory, conversation retention, private sessions, analytics, exports, deletion, and consent history.

screens.title: Accessibility
screens.summary: Set text size, contrast, reduced motion, screen-reader labels, captions, haptics, and voice controls.

screens.title: Notification controls
screens.summary: Choose categories, timing, neutral lock-screen language, quiet hours, and complete opt-out.

screens.title: Security
screens.summary: Manage device lock, active sessions, sign-in methods, recovery, and sign-out from all devices.

screens.title: I AM Premium
screens.summary: Show entitlement, included features, store-managed billing, cancellation information, and restore purchase.

screens.title: Support
screens.summary: Open technical, billing, privacy, unsafe-AI, safety-resource correction, and general support paths.

screens.title: Private support options
screens.summary: Reach immediate-danger information, safer-device guidance, planning education, and verified resources.

screens.title: Delete your account
screens.summary: Explain scope, store-subscription handling, limited lawful retention, verification, token revocation, and permanent deletion.

areas.label: Admin & Operations
areas.description: Protected reports, resources, incidents, support, audit, content, entitlements, and system health.

screens.title: Operations dashboard
screens.summary: See report queues, resource expirations, incidents, support load, system health, and audit alerts without exposing unnecessary user content.

screens.title: Reports queue
screens.summary: Triage unsafe AI, community harm, privacy issues, resource corrections, and technical reports by severity and status.

screens.title: Report review
screens.summary: Review the minimum necessary evidence, assign severity, record action, and preserve an audit trail.

screens.title: Resource governance
screens.summary: Review draft, pending, verified, expired, suspended, and retired resources with sources and verification history.

screens.title: Verify a resource
screens.summary: Confirm official source, jurisdiction, contact methods, hours, languages, accessibility, reviewer, and next review date.

screens.title: Incident response
screens.summary: Track severity, containment, affected surfaces, evidence, rollback, communication, correction, and post-incident review.

screens.title: Support requests
screens.summary: Handle technical, billing, privacy, deletion, resource, unsafe-AI, and general requests with role-based access.

screens.title: Approved content
screens.summary: Manage reviewed education, help, safety, career, relationship, wellness, and style content with version and approval metadata.

screens.title: Audit trail
screens.summary: Review protected records of administrative access and changes without allowing client-side access.

screens.title: Entitlements and purchase events
screens.summary: Review verified store lifecycle events, entitlement state, refunds, expirations, and webhook processing without exposing payment credentials.

screens.title: System health
screens.summary: See authentication, database, Edge Function, AI, notification, purchase, error, and queue health with alert ownership.
